feed.circleText: Your contacts are being created. Head to Chats to meet each one as soon as they’re ready. Posts will appear here as you get to know them.

feed.emptyTitle: A feed that grows with you
feed.emptyText: Chat with your contacts or follow a topic you’re into. They’ll bring fresh posts here when there’s something to share.
feed.followNote: Your contacts decide how to show it and who keeps it up to date. Public questions may be searched on the web.
feed.topicsNote: Your contacts add and retire their own picks as your interests change. Topics you or a contact asked for stay until you hide them.
